commitResults.messageTitle: Add optional remark to Person model
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce a Remark value class that accepts any non-null text.
Extend Person with remark access, equality, hashing, and string output.
Keep existing constructors compatible by defaulting to an empty remark.

Add tests for remark values, constructor defaults, and person identity.
Validation: complete Gradle check passed with Java 25.

commitResults.messageTitle: Support remarks in add and preserve them on edit
commitResults.messageBody:
Accept an optional r/ prefix when adding a person, default to an empty
remark, and reject repeated remark prefixes. Preserve the existing
remark when editing other fields to avoid losing student notes.

Update command usage and test helpers, and add regression tests for
optional remarks, repeated prefixes, and preservation during edits.

Validation: complete Gradle check passed with Java 25.

commitResults.messageTitle: Persist remarks and display them on student cards
commitResults.messageBody:
Save and load remarks through the JSON person adapter. Default missing
or null remarks to empty text so existing data files remain usable.

Display remarks in a wrapping student card label and hide empty remarks.
Add JSON round-trip, legacy-data, and file persistence tests.

Validation: complete Gradle check passed with Java 25.

Reject remarks exceeding 4000 Unicode code points in the model,
add command, and JSON loading. Report the same validation message
through the parser and storage error paths.

Add boundary, Unicode, and persistence regression tests.
Gradle check, coverage, and shadowJar passed with 270 tests.
Add Bryan's portfolio and update AboutUs

commitResults.messageTitle: test(studentId)!: Use student ID as Person identity

instead of name.

data, and include it in JSON storage fixtures and validation so
duplicate detection is based on the new identifier.

The failing test used to expect a default student ID.
Now it reuses the edited person's student ID.
